units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 14a:9">M. Kat. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>אֵיזוֹרוֹ וכ׳</he> his girdle (around his house-gown) testifies for him (that he has no more than the shirt he is washing).
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevuot 5:12">Tosef. Shebu. V, 12</cite> sq.; a. e.—Pl. <he>אֵזוֹרִים</he>, <cite ref="A00987"><he>אֵיז׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:6">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>אֵזוֹרֵי מתניהם וכ׳</he> they loosened the girdles of their loins (in mourning sympathy). [Ch. <he>זריז</he>.]
